_note: Research collector settings. Safe to edit. No secrets here: credentials live only in .env. See docs/research-data.md.
_contact_note: Optional contact (a URL or address you are happy to send) added to the User-Agent; Wikimedia asks API users for one.

youtube._budget_note: Google gives 10,000 units/day plus 100 search calls/day; these budgets leave headroom. Quota days reset at midnight US Pacific.
youtube._growth_note: Rows of one video within observation_merge_minutes count as one observation moment (e.g. the same video in the MX and ES charts). Growth is only calculated between moments at least min_growth_hours apart.

twitch._terms_note: Set true by the owner on 2026-11-24 after reading the Twitch Developer Services Agreement storage clause (docs/research-data.md, Twitch). Live Twitch calls are refused until then.
twitch._share_note: false keeps Twitch reports in data/local/research/twitch/reports instead of exports/share until onward transfer is confirmed.

sentiment._note: Gates for `ss sentiment` (Stage 4.7). See docs/audience-sentiment.md. Owner-controlled.
sentiment._manual_note: Comments a person copies from public pages (TikTok, Instagram, Reddit, DevForum, YouTube pages) and pastes in. No scraping or browser automation.
sentiment.youtube_amendment_basis: Owner confirmed on 2026-11-25 that the YouTube derived-metrics approval was obtained (accepted when the API key was created) and re-confirmed it at Stage 4.7 acceptance.
sentiment._youtube_note: Derived-metrics amendment (YouTube API Services form, Section 5 > Analytics & Reporting): https://developers.google.com/youtube/terms/derived-metrics-policy (last updated 2026-09-14). Allows NLP sentiment on API comments; derived results up to 36 months; comment text still 30 days; no inferring protected attributes. Add Google's confirmation reference above when available. Set false if acceptance is withdrawn.
sentiment._export_note: false: comment text is never copied to exports/share (ChatGPT/Gemini). Coded summaries without text can be exported. Claude codes comments locally in this workspace.
sentiment._youtube_amendment_reference: Paste the confirmation date or reference from the Google Cloud console here when available; the feature stays on meanwhile on the owner's confirmation.
